title: agent-skills eval result (unprimed invocation or forced-exposure efficacy)

condition.description: unprimed: real invocation test, the case's own setup.priming applies unmodified. forced: a specific skill's content was deliberately injected into context to test efficacy independent of invocation — NOT a measurement of whether the skill would have fired on its own. Absent means unprimed, for backward compatibility with results recorded before this field existed.

scores.description: criterion id -> pass|fail|not_evaluated. Open by design: adding a criterion to a case must not invalidate old results.
